    Changelog

    DxPower 0.1.0

    • Initial dev version.

    Functions

    • power.copr.test(): power or sample size of a single-test design (superiority against fixed minimum sensitivity and specificity), with Wald or logit approximation. Give exactly one of N or power.
    • power.copr.comp.test(): comparative designs, unpaired and paired, with superiority or non-inferiority per endpoint. The paired design uses the discordance (psi.d, psi.nd) or the phi correlation (rho.d, rho.nd) of the two tests.
    • paired_bounds(), rho_to_psi() and psi_to_rho(): feasible range of the discordance and correlation and conversion between them.
    • ss.copr.conv(): conventional single-test sample size (per-endpoint sample size divided by prevalence, maximum over the endpoints).
    • power.copr.emp() and power.copr.comp.emp(): Monte Carlo power for the single-test and the unpaired design.

    Exact power

    • exact = TRUE computes exact binomial power (single-test and unpaired designs). This is an experimental feature and it needs further development and testing.

    Behaviour

    • Overall power is the product of the endpoint powers (the diseased and non-diseased samples are independent).
    • Inputs are validated (probabilities, sample sizes, n_sim). A warning is given if the effective one-sided level is above 0.025.
    • Results are of class power.htest.
